errors.text_span: Има една синя линия с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The chart contains two separate data series: a solid blue line and a series of blue circular markers. The description incorrectly conflates them into a single series.
The description completely omits one of the two data series present in the chart (the series represented by blue dots).
The description states the final value is 20000, but the solid line ends at approximately 22,500 and the dotted series ends at approximately 21,000.

errors.text_span: Линията показва постоянен, но бавен наклон нагоре по оста X
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. The solid line has a noticeable flat section between 2019 and 2020, followed by a much steeper incline, which contradicts the claim of a 'constant' slope.
